text: Borrowed strength... always sends you a bill.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Machiavelli studied rulers who won with a borrowed army... then became its prisoner.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: For losing, one is undone... and winning, one is their captive.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: He retells an old story. Young David offers to face a giant.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: King Saul hands him his own armour. Heavy. Polished. Royal.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: David takes it off. He can't use it. He walks out... with his sling.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Today, the armour is the friend who writes all your code... or the one client your shop can't lose.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: The arms of others either fall from your back... or they weigh you down... or they bind you fast.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: That doesn't mean refuse all help. But the skill that saves you... must be yours.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Pick one job you always hand to someone else. Do it yourself, once, today.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: What's your sling? Tell me in the comments.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural

text: Follow Awaaz... and build your own strength.
name: en-US-ChristopherNeural
